integrity.mathematical_claim: optimal discrete-Morse vector (1,3,56,0,0,0) on the original open-neighborhood simplicial complex; integral homology consequences

scientific_limitations: Exact matching and integral computations concern only the 27-vertex Hamming graph H(3,3).
Kahle already supplies an abstract homotopy-dimension-two upper bound for graphs without \(K_{2,3}\); the distinguishing assertion is a perfect matching on the original triangulation.
Matsushita and Behal–Chih establish closely related graph-walk fundamental-group results, so the free-abelian group calculation is not independently claimed as new.
The complete attaching maps, higher homotopy groups, and other Hamming parameters are not classified.
An equivalent optimal matching could exist in unindexed literature.
title: A perfect discrete-Morse matching for the ternary three-cube neighborhood complex
